## Acronyms {.unnumbered .unlisted}


## YAML keys {.unnumbered .unlisted}

- `bands`: the list of radiation-band configurations. Defined in [Matching the spectral measure (`weight` or `wavenumber`)](#sec-ch07-spectral).
- `flags`: the comma-separated solver options. Defined in [Matching the spectral measure (`weight` or `wavenumber`)](#sec-ch07-spectral).
- `name`: the band identifier. Defined in [Matching the spectral measure (`weight` or `wavenumber`)](#sec-ch07-spectral).
- `nstr`: the discrete-ordinate stream count. Defined in [Matching the spectral measure (`weight` or `wavenumber`)](#sec-ch07-spectral).
- `nwave`: the number of spectral points. Defined in [Matching the spectral measure (`weight` or `wavenumber`)](#sec-ch07-spectral).
- `opacities`: the list of opacity-source names used by the band. Defined in [Matching the spectral measure (`weight` or `wavenumber`)](#sec-ch07-spectral).
- `range`: the pair of spectral endpoints, interpreted as wavenumbers by default. Defined in [Matching the spectral measure (`weight` or `wavenumber`)](#sec-ch07-spectral).
- `solver`: the transfer-solver selector. Defined in [Matching the spectral measure (`weight` or `wavenumber`)](#sec-ch07-spectral).
